Projects.Name: AWS.AgentGovernance.Bedrock
ChangelogMessages: Initial preview release (0.1.0-preview): AWS backends for Microsoft's Agent Governance Toolkit. Adds a Bedrock Guardrails policy backend (IExternalPolicyBackend, fail-closed), Bedrock Guardrails PII sanitization of MCP tool output, and a CloudWatch audit sink with metrics. Configure via WithBedrockGovernance (MCP), AddBedrockGovernance (DI), or the GovernanceKernel extensions.
